product_overview: Padhaanewala is an education discovery and counselling platform for browsing colleges, courses, exams, scholarships, reviews, and blog content. It also supports admissions enquiries, AI-assisted guidance, student account features, mock tests, and admin-managed catalog operations.
core_goals: Discover and compare colleges, courses, exams, and scholarships
Search and navigate directly to relevant education details from the homepage
Register, log in, and manage access to protected student features
Submit enquiries and admission leads through validated forms
Save colleges, read notifications, and manage student dashboard content
Take mock tests and review results
Use the AI assistant for education guidance
Browse reviews, blogs, and static informational content
Access admin-only management areas with role-based restrictions

features.name: Home search and quick actions
features.description: Users can search from the homepage hero, open matching education detail pages, and use shortcut tiles to jump into key discovery areas.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type a college, course, or exam name -> Select a matching suggestion -> See the corresponding detail page
Navigate to / -> Click a quick action tile -> See the related exploration page
Navigate to / -> Scroll through featured colleges, banners, and testimonials -> Observe highlighted content

features.name: College discovery and detail
features.description: Users can browse colleges with filters, sorting, and pagination, then open a college detail page to inspect rankings, fees, placements, cutoffs, seat matrix, FAQs, and reviews.
user_flows: Navigate to /colleges -> Filter by state, city, course, university, or fee range -> Sort results -> Move through pages -> Open a college card -> See the college detail page with overview information
Navigate to /colleges -> Apply a restrictive filter combination -> Observe an empty results state
Navigate to /colleges -> Open a college detail page -> Switch between overview, rankings, fees, placements, cutoffs, seat matrix, and FAQ sections -> Review the displayed information
Navigate to /colleges -> Open an unknown college page URL -> Observe the not-found state

features.name: Course, exam, and scholarship browsing
features.description: Users can search and filter course, exam, and scholarship listings, then open detail pages for eligibility, dates, syllabus, and career information.
user_flows: Navigate to /courses -> Search or filter the catalog -> Open a course detail page -> Review eligibility and career information
Navigate to /exams -> Filter exams by type or conducting authority -> Open an exam detail page -> Review dates, eligibility, syllabus, and FAQ content
Navigate to /scholarships -> Filter scholarships by state or eligibility -> Open a scholarship detail page -> Review matching scholarship information

features.name: Compare colleges
features.description: Users can compare up to the supported number of colleges side by side to evaluate fees, rankings, placements, and courses.
user_flows: Navigate to /compare -> Add colleges to the comparison set -> View the side-by-side comparison table -> Compare fees, rankings, placements, and courses
Navigate to /compare -> Remove one college from the comparison set -> Observe the comparison table update
Navigate to /compare -> Add more colleges than supported -> Observe validation feedback

features.name: Authentication and session management
features.description: Users can register, log in with email/password or OTP, and log out while protected routes enforce access rules.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter valid email and password -> Submit the form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter an incorrect password -> Submit the form -> See an inline authentication error
Navigate to /login -> Enter an empty or malformed email -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /login -> Register with an email already in use -> Submit the form -> See a duplicate-account error
Navigate to /login -> Request an OTP -> Verify the OTP -> See the authenticated session established
Navigate to a protected route while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login
While signed in, log out -> Attempt to revisit a protected route -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Password recovery and email verification
features.description: Users can request password recovery, set a new password with a token, and manage email verification state.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter a valid email -> Submit the form -> See confirmation of the reset request
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter an invalid email format -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /reset-password -> Open the page with an invalid token -> Observe the error state
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter mismatched passwords -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /verify-email -> Open the page with a valid token -> See verification status
Navigate to /verify-email -> Open the page with an invalid token -> Observe the error state
Navigate to /verify-email -> Request resend verification -> Observe the resend action

features.name: Enquiry and admission lead submission
features.description: Users can submit contact or admission enquiries using validated lead forms.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name, email, mobile number, message, and consent -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to /admission -> Fill in name, email, mobile number, message, and consent -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to /contact -> Enter an invalid mobile number -> Submit the form -> See field-level validation feedback
Navigate to /contact -> Enter an invalid email address -> Submit the form -> See field-level validation feedback
Navigate to /contact -> Leave consent unchecked -> Submit the form -> See the required-consent error

features.name: Add college submission
features.description: Authenticated users can suggest a new college and manage their own submitted entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /add-college while signed in -> Fill in the college suggestion form completely -> Submit the form -> See confirmation
Navigate to /add-college while signed in -> Leave required fields blank -> Submit the form -> See validation errors
Navigate to /add-college while signed in -> Open the personal submissions list -> See previously submitted colleges
Navigate to /add-college while signed in -> Open one of own submissions -> Edit the details -> Save changes -> See the updated submission
Navigate to /add-college while signed in -> Open one of own submissions -> Delete it -> See it removed
Navigate to /add-college while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Student dashboard, saved colleges, and notifications
features.description: Authenticated students can view their dashboard, manage saved colleges, and read notifications.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard while signed in -> See the personalized dashboard
Navigate to /colleges -> Open a college detail page -> Save the college -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See the college in saved items
Navigate to /dashboard -> Remove a saved college -> Observe it disappear from the saved list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open notifications -> Read the unread list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Mark one notification as read -> Observe the updated unread state
Navigate to /dashboard -> Mark all notifications as read -> Observe the list clear
Navigate to /dashboard while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Mock tests
features.description: Authenticated users can browse mock test papers, start attempts, answer questions under a timer, submit, and review results.
user_flows: Navigate to /mock-tests while signed in -> Select a paper -> Review the setup instructions -> Start the attempt
Navigate to /mock-tests while signed in -> Answer questions -> Move through the question palette -> Flag questions as needed -> Submit the attempt -> See the result breakdown
Navigate to /mock-tests while signed in -> Start an attempt -> Let the timer expire -> Observe automatic submission -> See results
Navigate to /mock-tests while signed in -> Start an attempt -> Submit early -> See the result breakdown
Navigate to /mock-tests while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: AI assistant
features.description: Users can ask the AI assistant questions about colleges, exams, and admissions through a full-page chat or floating widget.
user_flows: Navigate to /ask-ai -> Type a question -> Send it -> See the assistant reply in the conversation
Navigate to /ask-ai -> Clear the conversation -> Observe the transcript reset
Navigate to /ask-ai -> Submit an empty message -> Observe input rejection
Navigate to any page with the floating widget available -> Open the chat widget -> Type a question -> Receive an answer in the widget

features.name: Reviews, blog, and comparison content
features.description: Users can browse ratings and reviews, read blog articles, and use blog pagination.
user_flows: Navigate to /reviews -> Filter reviews by rating or entity -> Observe the filtered list
Navigate to /blog -> Move through pagination -> Open a blog article -> Read the article detail page
Navigate to /blog -> Open a nonexistent article URL -> Observe the not-found state

features.name: Predictor, planner, and static content pages
features.description: Users can use the college predictor and suggestion questionnaire, and open informational pages such as planning, resources, about, and legal documents.
user_flows: Navigate to /college-predictor -> Enter rank, category, and preferences -> Submit the form -> See predicted colleges
Navigate to /college-predictor -> Leave required inputs empty -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /suggest-college -> Complete the questionnaire -> See matching college suggestions
Navigate to /plan -> /resources -> /about -> /legal/[slug] -> Observe the informational page headings render
Navigate to /legal/[slug] with an unknown slug -> Observe the not-found state

features.name: Admin console role-gated operations
features.description: Admin users can access the management console to work with catalog, leads, users, analytics, and settings; unauthorized users are blocked.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login
Navigate to /admin while signed in as a student -> See access denied or redirect behavior before admin content loads
Navigate to /admin while signed in with admin access -> Move between admin sections -> See the selected section render
Navigate to /admin while signed in with admin access -> Open a catalog form -> Enter invalid values -> Submit -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /admin while signed in with admin access -> Search and paginate users or leads -> See table results update

features.name: Compliance, age gate, and data requests
features.description: Authenticated users can declare age, manage parental consent, and submit data access or deletion requests.
user_flows: Navigate to the age gate flow -> Declare age above the threshold -> Continue to the site experience
Navigate to the age gate flow -> Declare age below the threshold -> Follow the parental consent path
Navigate to compliance settings while signed in -> Request parental consent -> Verify consent -> Withdraw consent
Navigate to compliance requests -> Submit a data access request -> See the request recorded
Navigate to compliance requests -> Submit a duplicate request -> Observe request validation or conflict handling

tech_stack: other: Vitest, FastAPI backend proxied at same-origin /api/v1, JWT access token plus HttpOnly refresh cookie

known_limitations.issue: Frontend is running via next dev; TestSprite limits frontend runs to 15 high-priority tests in development mode
known_limitations.impact: Only a subset of the mapped workflows can be executed in this run; deeper RBAC and CRUD coverage needs a production build/serve

known_limitations.issue: Next.js 16.4.2 emits a known-security-vulnerability upgrade recommendation at dev startup
known_limitations.impact: Security upgrade is outstanding and was not applied because source/dependency changes require user approval

known_limitations.issue: The configured TestSprite login user has only the student role; admin and staff role gates cannot be exercised end to end
known_limitations.impact: Admin console tests are limited to negative/redirect checks rather than successful CRUD

known_limitations.issue: AI assistant requires an OpenAI-compatible provider and key; none is configured in the local test environment
known_limitations.impact: AI chat tests can only verify the request/loading/error UI, not a real answer

known_limitations.issue: Email/SMS providers are no-op in development, so reset and verification tokens are not delivered to a real inbox or phone
known_limitations.impact: Password-reset and OTP workflows are tested for validation and error states rather than full token completion

known_limitations.issue: Some catalog categories are empty in the seed data
known_limitations.impact: Explorer pages may correctly render empty states, which can be mistaken for missing data by naive assertions
